heading: INT. ICE RINK - RESURFACER GARAGE - NIGHT

units.text: INT. ICE RINK - RESURFACER GARAGE - NIGHT
A concrete bay with a hulking resurfacing machine, drips from the ceiling, a flickering overhead tube.
The big door is shut.
The cold bites.
ROXANNE (30s, parka) crouches by the machine's wheel with a flashlight.
GUS (50s, rink manager, keys on a lanyard) holds the clipboard.
TAMSIN (teen, hockey jersey, skates over her shoulder) stays near the door.
Roxanne, the water tank's been leaking since Tuesday.
units.name: GUS

units.text: It's not water, Gus.
units.name: ROXANNE

units.text: She points the flashlight.
A dark red trail runs from the machine's blade toward the drain.
I'm going to get my dad.
units.name: TAMSIN

units.text: Tamsin, stay here.
units.name: GUS

units.text: It smells like pennies, Mr. Gus.
units.name: TAMSIN

units.text: The machine's engine coughs once.
Nobody touched it.
Gus drops his clipboard.
Roxanne stands.
Under the machine's belly, a FIGURE uncurls, grey and frost-furred, long fingers dragging the concrete.
Don't move.
units.name: ROXANNE

units.text: The Figure rises.
Its blue lips shape words that make no sound.
It takes a step toward Tamsin.
Gus swings his keys like a flail.
The Figure catches his wrist.
They struggle.
Roxanne grabs a pry bar and slams it into the thing's ribs.
It shrieks, soundless, and throws them both against the wall.
Run!
units.name: TAMSIN

units.text: All three scatter.
The Figure watches them go, then folds back under the machine, patient.
